title: Can LB Jordan Turner crack the Broncos 53-man roster?

sources.title: Can LB Jordan Turner crack the Broncos 53-man roster?
sources.description: Linebacker Jordan Turner had a bit of a unique road to the NFL. After a successful college career at Wisconsin and Michigan State, Turner declared for the 2025 NFL Draft. Unfortunately, after seven rounds, Turner did not hear his name called, and he would become an undrafted free agent. That signing process moves quickly, but […]
